description: Implement the connection-per-tool-call model that preserves ADR 0005 G1 as amended by ADR 0006 G3: map each tool to a CredentialMode using the same table the CLI uses per command, resolve a capability-scoped credential for that call only, open a fresh connection, and close it on return so a read-only tool never holds a read-write credential. Add a TodoDatabase open path that does not run _migrate() so write tools do not silently migrate; migrate stays a floor CLI verb. Reset the credential-provider cache and re-resolve on E_AUTH_REJECTED. Gate a behind/ahead schema to E_SCHEMA.

preserves.behavior: A long-lived server does not open a hosted primary by default
A write tool call never triggers schema migration
No agent holds ambient standing read-write authority (ADR 0005 G1 as amended)
The audit-head consistency check still runs on the open path
